patthana21.46:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana21.46:2.1: na no āsavaṃ sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā ekaṃ, (gaṇitakena tīṇi,)
patthana21.46:3.1: no āsavaṃ na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca purimanayena tīṇi pañhā.
patthana21.46:4.1: no āsavaṃ na anidassana appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo anidassana appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ. na āsavaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
